subject: Descriptor
note: MeSH topical descriptors (D-ids) are what PubMed indexing and HumanMine's MeshTerm use

subject: Concept
note: no InterMine class for MeSH concepts

subject: Term
note: no synonyms/terms field on MeshTerm; the preferred label is already MeshTerm.name

subject: Qualifier
note: no InterMine class for MeSH qualifiers (subheadings)

subject: TreeNumber
note: no field for MeSH tree numbers; MeshTerm is flat

subject: PublicationType
note: a different MeSH record type, reached via seeAlso; not a Descriptor

subject: CheckTag
note: a different MeSH record type; unreachable from Descriptor

subject: Geographic
note: a different MeSH record type; unreachable from Descriptor

subject: Chemical
note: supplementary concept record, not a Descriptor; unreachable

subject: Disease
note: subject name is the model class Disease

subject: Protocol
note: supplementary concept record, not a Descriptor; unreachable

subject: Organism
note: subject name is the model class Organism

subject: AllowedDescriptorQualifierPair
note: descriptor/qualifier pairing; no model class; unreachable

subject: DisallowedDescriptorQualifierPair
note: descriptor/qualifier pairing; no model class; unreachable
